# age testkit vectors

This directory vendors the complete official C2SP CCTV `age/testdata` corpus.

- Upstream: https://github.com/C2SP/CCTV/tree/1e3d2860d46e94e777e1b17c7a6f2436387e3ecc/age/testdata
- Pinned commit: `1e3d2860d46e94e777e1b17c7a6f2436387e3ecc`
- Vector count: 143
- License: CC0-1.0

Each vector contains textual metadata, a blank line, and an age file. Some
payloads are zlib-compressed as declared by their metadata. Do not edit
individual vectors; refresh the directory from the pinned upstream tree.
